recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the explicit FHIR-50601 datatype decision. Any broader expansion of recommendation targets, such as adding other request-pattern resources not present in the final Jira-applied list, should be handled as separate OO work.
issue_request: FHIR-50601 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 after the reporter noted that DiagnosticReport.recommendation was a CodeableReference with no value set for its codeable side. The OO decision was to change the element to Reference and constrain the reference targets to request-like follow-up resources.
initial_application: FHIR-45290 originally added DiagnosticReport.recomendation as CodeableReference(Any). The FHIR-50601 implementation commit 8668f53ceed4f0713137246b13b6f08bb9163b5d narrowed the targetProfile list from Resource to specific follow-up resources, but left the datatype as CodeableReference. FHIR-54163 later corrected the element spelling to DiagnosticReport.recommendation.
additional_context: OO WGM minutes for 2025-05-12/15 confirm the FHIR-50601 motion to change the datatype to Reference. Later commit e073fb45ec6f5a738a9f674baf63406bfe90fb78 removed ImmunizationRecommendation from the active core resource list and from DiagnosticReport references, so this reconciliation did not restore that now-out-of-build target. source/fhir.ini lists DiagnosticReport as an active resource.
reconciliation: This commit changes the authoritative DiagnosticReport StructureDefinition source from CodeableReference to Reference for DiagnosticReport.recommendation, preserving the current targetProfile list after later resource-scope changes. It also updates the checked-in DiagnosticReport SVG so the visible resource diagram matches the source datatype.
source_changes: source/diagnosticreport/structuredefinition-DiagnosticReport.xml: changed DiagnosticReport.recommendation type code from CodeableReference to Reference.
source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport.svg: changed the DiagnosticReport.recommendation diagram label/link from CodeableReference to Reference.
